name: agent-workbench-gui
description: Agent Workbench desktop console (formal GUI shell)
author: mkmk56

scripts.predev: npm run theme:build && npm run build:main
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,tsc,electron -c cyan,yellow,green "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run theme:build && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
